toegepas.voor: as dit aspris gebeur en weer en weer gebeur
toegepas.na: as dit aspris en oor en oor gebeur
toegepas.rede_vinder: 'weer en weer' is listed as NIE for the protected marker 'oor en oor', which the study text must give word for word; this also removes the doubled 'gebeur'.
toegepas.fout: The study text uses 'weer en weer', the NIE form of the protected marker 'oor en oor', and repeats 'gebeur'.
toegepas.rede_keurder: Restores the protected marker word for word and removes the doubled verb without moving the meaning.

toegepas.voor: Die kind of die groep wat dit doen
toegepas.na: Die kind of groep wat dit doen
toegepas.rede_vinder: The protected wording is 'Die kind of groep'; the lesson has an extra 'die' and so does not carry it.
toegepas.fout: The extra 'die' means the protected wording 'Die kind of groep' is not carried.
toegepas.rede_keurder: Brings the sentence onto the protected wording; same people, same meaning.

toegepas.voor: Kry dan wat jy soek op 'n ander manier.
toegepas.na: Kry dan op 'n ander manier wat jy soek.
toegepas.rede_vinder: The adverbial reads more naturally before the object clause than after it.
toegepas.fout: 'op 'n ander manier' after 'wat jy soek' can be read as part of the relative clause (seeking in another way).
toegepas.rede_keurder: Placing the adverbial before the object clause attaches it clearly to 'kry' and reads more naturally.

toegepas.voor: dat jy dit amper sonder dink doen
toegepas.na: dat jy dit amper sonder om te dink doen
toegepas.rede_vinder: 'sonder' before a verb needs 'om te'; 'sonder dink' is colloquial.
toegepas.fout: 'sonder dink' lacks the 'om te' that 'sonder' before a verb requires in standard Afrikaans.
toegepas.rede_keurder: A plain grammar fix in a definition that is not on the protected or shared list, with the meaning unchanged.

laat_vaar.blok: 'n Rede maak dit nie reg nie
laat_vaar.na: 'n Rede help jou om te verstaan
laat_vaar.rede_vinder: 'help jou om te verstaan' is the standard construction; the bare infinitive is colloquial.
laat_vaar.rede_keurder: 'help jou verstaan' with a bare infinitive is accepted, natural Afrikaans, so the change is lateral and only more formal.

laat_vaar.na: as jy wil ophou om af te knou
laat_vaar.rede_vinder: 'ophou' takes 'om te' plus the infinitive; 'ophou afknou' is colloquial.
laat_vaar.rede_keurder: 'ophou' with a bare infinitive (as in 'ophou rook') is standard and matches the lesson title 'Om op te hou afknou'; the proposal is longer and lateral.

na_skrywer.blok: Maak reg met 'n grootmens se hulp
na_skrywer.voor: Hy vra ook hoe, soos met 'n briefie.
na_skrywer.na: Die grootmens vra ook hoe jy jammer moet sê, soos met 'n briefie.
na_skrywer.rede_vinder: 'Hy' directly follows a 'hy' meaning the other child, so it is unclear who asks; 'hoe' also dangles without its verb.
na_skrywer.fout: 'Hy' follows a 'hy' meaning the other child, so it is unclear who asks, and 'hoe' dangles.
na_skrywer.rede_keurder: A real ambiguity, but it sits in the apology procedure that protects the bullied child (who asks whom, what), which the writer owns; the proposal also repeats 'die grootmens' and drops whom is asked.
na_skrywer.waarom: the reviewer sent it to the writer

na_skrywer.rede_vinder: 'langs' means physically beside; 'naas' is the Afrikaans for 'in addition to' (English 'alongside').
na_skrywer.fout: 'langs' used in the English sense of 'alongside / in addition to' is a mild anglicism.
na_skrywer.rede_keurder: This is help-seeking wording about Childline and the adults, which the writer owns, and 'naas' is formal for Grade 6 and can read as 'second to', so the fault needs the writer's fix.
na_skrywer.waarom: the reviewer sent it to the writer

na_skrywer.rede_vinder: Same as the previous block: 'naas' means 'in addition to', 'langs' means physically beside.
na_skrywer.fout: 'langs' used in the English sense of 'alongside / in addition to' is a mild anglicism.
na_skrywer.rede_keurder: Same help-seeking wording as change 7; the writer should fix both together, in plain words that keep 'extra help, not instead of the adults'.
na_skrywer.waarom: the reviewer sent it to the writer

vlae.teks: Hou op om saam te doen.
vlae.rede: 'saam te doen' does not say what the child joins in with; making it explicit (for example joining in when the group bullies) would need the writer, because it adds content.
